interviewer.authenticationDialog.limited.defaultMessage: Biometric authentication isn't available in this installed app. Enter your recovery passphrase instead.

interviewer.authenticationDialog.unlockW.description: Button in the unlock dialog that starts biometric authentication (fingerprint, face or device screen lock) to open the locked app.

interviewer.authenticationDialog.unlocki.description: Label of the unlock button while the entered PIN or passphrase is being checked.

interviewer.biometric.limitedWindow.defaultMessage: Biometric unlock isn't available in the installed app on macOS, because Chrome can't reach your Mac's saved passkeys from an app window. Use a PIN or passphrase instead.
interviewer.biometric.limitedWindow.description: Reason shown in the security setup method picker for why the biometric option is disabled: the installed app window on macOS cannot reach saved passkeys.

interviewer.biometric.unsupported.defaultMessage: This browser or device does not support biometric unlock. Use a PIN or passphrase instead.
interviewer.biometric.unsupported.description: Reason shown in the security setup method picker for why the biometric option is disabled: this browser or device lacks support. The PIN and passphrase options remain.

interviewer.biometricUnlockForm.unlockFa.description: Fallback error shown under the biometric unlock button when biometric authentication fails with no more specific reason.

interviewer.biometricUnlockForm.unlockWi.description: Default label of the biometric unlock button, used when the caller does not supply one. "Authenticator" is the device's biometric or passkey method.

interviewer.biometricUnlockForm.waitingF.description: Label of the biometric unlock button while the device's fingerprint, face or passkey prompt is open and awaiting the researcher.

interviewer.dataView.allStrongSelectedCo.defaultMessage: {selectedCount, plural, one {The # matching interview is selected.} other {All # matching interviews are selected.}}
interviewer.dataView.allStrongSelectedCo.description: Banner above the interview table after selection was extended to every interview matching the current filters. selectedCount is that number; strong makes it bold.

interviewer.dataView.clearSelection.description: Action that deselects interviews without deleting or changing them.

interviewer.dataView.loadingInterviews.description: Placeholder shown in the empty interview table while interviews are still being read from the device.

interviewer.dataViewColumns.caseID.description: Sortable column header in the interview table for the case ID, the identifier the researcher gave the participant.

interviewer.dataViewColumns.notExported.description: Cell text in the export status column for an interview that has never been exported; a state, not an instruction.

interviewer.dataViewColumns.progress.description: Sortable column header in the interview table for how far through its stages each interview is.

interviewer.dataViewColumns.protocol.description: Sortable column header in the interview table for the name of the protocol (interview design) each interview used.

interviewer.dataViewColumns.resume.description: Row action that opens an unfinished interview for further data collection.

interviewer.dataViewColumns.review.description: Row action that opens a finished interview without saving changes.

interviewer.dataViewColumns.selectAllInt.defaultMessage: Select all interviews on this page
interviewer.dataViewColumns.selectAllInt.description: Accessible name of the checkbox in the interview table header that selects every interview on the current page, read only by screen readers.

interviewer.dataViewColumns.selectCase.description: Accessible name of a row checkbox in the interview table, read only by screen readers. caseId is the case ID of that row.

interviewer.dataViewColumns.started.description: Sortable column header in the interview table for when each interview was started.

interviewer.dataViewColumns.stepProgress.defaultMessage: {hasTotal, select, true {step {step, number} of {total, number}} other {step {step, number} of ?}}

interviewer.dataViewColumns.updated.description: Sortable column header in the interview table for when each interview was last changed.

interviewer.dataViewToolbar.clearAllFilt.description: Button in the filter panel that removes every active filter and shows all interviews again.

interviewer.dataViewToolbar.complete.description: Filter option for interviews marked finished; this is a state, not an instruction to complete a task.

interviewer.dataViewToolbar.deleteSelect.description: Button that deletes the interviews selected in the table. count is the number of selected interviews. Delete is a verb.

interviewer.dataViewToolbar.deleting.description: Label of the bulk delete button while the selected interviews are being deleted; shown in place of the Delete count label.

interviewer.dataViewToolbar.exportSelect.description: Button that exports the interviews selected in the table to a file. count is the number of selected interviews. Export is a verb.

interviewer.dataViewToolbar.exportStatus.description: Label of the filter field in the filter panel that limits the table to exported or not-yet-exported interviews. Export is a noun here.

interviewer.dataViewToolbar.exported.description: Filter choice for interviews whose data has already been exported; a state, not an instruction.

interviewer.dataViewToolbar.exporting.description: Label of the bulk export button while the selected interviews are being exported; shown in place of the Export count label.

interviewer.dataViewToolbar.filterCount.description: Label of the filter panel button. count is the number of active filters: when 0 the button just says Filter, otherwise the count follows it.

interviewer.dataViewToolbar.filters.description: Label of the button that opens the filter panel above the interview table, shown when no filters are active.

interviewer.dataViewToolbar.notExported.description: Filter choice for interviews whose data has not been exported yet; a state, not an instruction.

interviewer.dataViewToolbar.protocol.description: Filter field selecting an installed research protocol.

interviewer.dataViewToolbar.started.description: Date filter for when an interview first began.

interviewer.dataViewToolbar.updated.description: Date filter for the most recent change to an interview.

interviewer.deckCard.requiresInternet.description: Protocol card badge warning that an interview stage needs an internet connection.

interviewer.deckSlotCard.dismissTheSampl.description: Accessible name of the delete icon button on the sample protocol card; removes the sample card from the deck. Read only by screen readers.

interviewer.deckSlotCard.extracting.description: Pending protocol card while the imported archive is being unpacked.

interviewer.deckSlotCard.installDevelopm.description: Button on the development protocol card that installs the bundled development protocol. Shown only in development builds, never to participants.

interviewer.deckSlotCard.installSamplePr.description: Button on the sample protocol card that installs the built-in sample protocol on this device. Verb phrase.

interviewer.deckSlotCard.saving.description: Pending protocol card while validated protocol content is saved on this device.

interviewer.deckSlotCard.startNewIntervi.description: Button at the bottom of the selected protocol card on the home screen; opens the form to begin a new interview with that protocol.

interviewer.exportDialog.archiveReady.description: Export dialog heading once the archive is built but has not yet been saved.

interviewer.exportDialog.contains.description: Line under the archive file name in the export dialog once it is built. count is the number of interviews inside the archive.

interviewer.exportDialog.copied.description: Acknowledgment on the export-error copy button after the clipboard write succeeds.

interviewer.exportDialog.errorDetailsCou.defaultMessage: Error details could not be copied.

interviewer.exportDialog.exportFailed.description: Title of the dialog shown when building the interview export archive failed. Also announced to screen readers.

interviewer.exportDialog.exportProgress.description: Accessible name of the progress bar in the export dialog, read only by screen readers. Export is a noun.

interviewer.exportDialog.exporting.description: Title of the export dialog while the archive is being built. count is the number of interviews being exported.

interviewer.exportDialog.failedDescripti.defaultMessage: The interview archive could not be created. Your saved interview data is unchanged. Copy the error details below if you need support.

interviewer.exportDialog.filesProgress.description: Small progress line under the progress bar in the export dialog. current is the number of files processed so far and total is the number of files to process.

interviewer.exportDialog.incomplete.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# interview could not be exported completely and may be missing from this archive.} other {# interviews could not be exported completely and may be missing from this archive.}}
interviewer.exportDialog.incomplete.description: Warning in the export dialog when some interviews could not be fully exported. count is the number of such interviews.

interviewer.exportDialog.saveAction.description: Action that opens a device file picker to save the already-built data archive.

interviewer.exportDialog.shareAction.description: Action that opens the device share sheet for the already-built data archive.

interviewer.importTriggerCard.drop.description: Import instructions; preserve the literal .netcanvas file extension inside the styled tag.

interviewer.setupWizardDialog.ifYouNeedH.description: Help paragraph on the first wizard step. link is the email address info@networkcanvas.com and link1 wraps the words for the community forum link; keep both tags around the matching text.

interviewer.setupWizardDialog.securingYo.description: Lead paragraph on the "Securing your data" step introducing the two layers of protection, data storage encryption and app authorization.

interviewer.setupWizardDialog.securitySt.defaultMessage: Security status could not be refreshed
interviewer.setupWizardDialog.securitySt.description: Error toast title shown after setup from Settings when the app cannot re-read the device security status.

interviewer.setupWizardDialog.setUpYourM.description: Title of the wizard step where the researcher configures the chosen unlock method (PIN, passphrase or biometric).

interviewer.setupWizardDialog.settingUpY.description: Lead paragraph on the first wizard step reassuring the researcher that setup is quick.

interviewer.setupWizardDialog.skipWizard.description: Action that requests skipping first-run security setup and using the app without a device lock.

interviewer.setupWizardDialog.storedSett.description: Error toast body under "Setup could not be opened"; stored app settings could not be read, so the researcher can try again.

interviewer.setupWizardDialog.yourDevice.description: Body of the confirmation shown when skipping first-run setup; warns the device will have no app lock and default preferences. Ends with a yes/no question.
